email.subject: Online aptitude test - QA Engineer application
email.body:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for applying for the QA Engineer role at Granite Peak Insurance. Every candidate at this stage completes an online aptitude test covering logical and numerical reasoning.

The test takes about 40 minutes and can be done whenever suits you. Please use the personal link below.

https://tests.granitepeak.example.com/apt/77k1

Kind regards,
Granite Peak Insurance Recruitment
